cover_source.imagery: Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA Copernicus) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
cover_source.water: McFeeters NDWI (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08) > 0.05 on the median
cover_source.classes: water if water share >= 0.5, green if green share >= 0.5, else mixed

provenance.boundary: Derived: the land island containing Sholadana bounded by OpenStreetMap river areas (natural=water water=river, waterway=river buffered 25 m), downloaded 6 Nov 2026 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); checked against BWDB/CEGIS EIA of Polder 23 (May 2021: gross area about 4,489 ha, 37 km embankment, bounded by the Shibsa, Kurulia and Minaj rivers) and against Sentinel-2 L2A S2B_MSIL2A_20260212T043809_R033_T45QYF (10 m, 12 Feb 2026, Planetary Computer)
provenance.gates: Approximate: main khal outlets digitised by eye where a visible khal meets the embankment on Sentinel-2 L2A S2B_MSIL2A_20260212T043809_R033_T45QYF (10 m, 12 Feb 2026, Planetary Computer); positions within about 150 m; real names and the other drainage and flushing sluices (BWDB lists 11 and 39) unknown until the BWDB Polder 23 map arrives (D-049).
provenance.canals: Approximate: main khals traced by eye on Sentinel-2 L2A S2B_MSIL2A_20260212T043809_R033_T45QYF (10 m, 12 Feb 2026, Planetary Computer); vertices within about 150 m; OpenStreetMap maps no khals inside the polder.
provenance.rivers: OpenStreetMap waterway=river lines within about 1.5 km of the polder, downloaded 6 Nov 2026 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). BWDB names the bounding rivers Shibsa, Kurulia and Minaj; OSM names only the Shibsa.
provenance.villages: Not yet available: OpenStreetMap has no village points inside the polder. Needs a georeferenced source with Bangla and English names (union parishad list plus BBS mouza maps), requested before P0-41.
